source.name: Footy Headlines: Tottenham & AIA End of Front-of-Shirt Era
source.note: Club-wide front-of-shirt deal runs through 2026/27 (also reported by Sportcal, 4 Nov 2025, which blocks scripts). The club's Women's Team Partners page (checked 2026-09-30) lists AIA as Global Principal Partner, and the club's 19 Jun 2026 kit gallery describes 'the home shirt our teams will wear for the 2026/27 season'.
source.quote: this means that AIA's front-of-shirt sponsorship will end after the 2026-27 season

source.name: Tottenham Hotspur – 'Tottenham Hotspur partners with Crypto Platform Kraken'
source.note: Club-wide sleeve deal from 2024/25; the club's Women's Team Partners page (checked 2026-09-30) still lists Kraken as Official Sleeve Partner.
source.quote: the Official Sleeve Partner for our Men's and Women's teams

source.name: Tottenham Hotspur – 'Tottenham Hotspur Women Announces Partnership with e.l.f. Cosmetics'
source.note: Announced ahead of the 2025/26 WSL season; the club's Women's Team Partners page (checked 2026-09-30) still lists e.l.f. ('Eyes. Lips. Face') as Official Back of Shirt Partner, confirming it continues in 2026/27.
source.quote: sees the brand become the new Official Back of Shirt Partner of Tottenham Hotspur Women

source.name: Tottenham Hotspur – 'Gallery: New Nike 2026/27 Home Kit up close'
source.note: Club kit launch for 2026/27 covering both teams ('our teams'); the Women's Team Partners page lists Nike as Official Kit Provider.
source.quote: Here's a closer look at the home shirt our teams will wear for the 2026/27 season. Classic Lilywhite, our Nike Home shirt is our nod to our heritage

summary: 2026/27 home shirt: Nike kit (partner), AIA front-of-shirt, Kraken sleeve, e.l.f. Cosmetics back-of-shirt. No shorts sponsor documented (Wikipedia's 2026–27 WSL kits table lists none).
